rounds.text: Richfield Financial Services Ltd is currently experiencing a profound operational turnaround, evidenced by a massive 169% compounded profit growth over the trailing twelve months [E21] and a 227% growth rate over the last three years [E20]. This momentum is further validated by a 150% year-over-year surge in sales [E64], which significantly outpaces the sector median profit growth of 22.8% [E75]. The market has failed to price in this acceleration, as the stock trades at a price-to-book ratio of 0.78x compared to a sector benchmark of 1.54x [E7]. Furthermore, the company demonstrates superior capital efficiency relative to its peers, maintaining a positive ROA of 3.85% and ROE of 3.93% in a sector where benchmarks are deeply negative at -104.7% and -11.79% respectively [E8, E9]. The disconnect between this fundamental improvement and the stock price is highlighted by the fact that profit growth currently exceeds one-year price growth by 211% [E56]. Conceded: [E4, E19, E26, E27, E28, E29, E61, E69, E70].
